newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Govt says good for NZers to control NZ assets.
newsitem.headline: Govt says good for NZers to control NZ assets.

text.p: The National-New Zealand First coalition document published on Wednesday said it was desirable for New Zealanders to control important national assets.

"While recognising the need for overseas capital and the need to maintain investor confidence, and without eroding any existing ownership rights, the coalition agrees that as a statement of general principle it is desirable that the control and ownership of important New Zealand assets and resources be held by New Zealanders," the document said.

The document defined generators Electricity Corporation and Contact Energy, national grid operator Trans Power, New Zealand Post, TV1 and Radio New Zealand's National and Concert FM programmes as strategic assets which would not be sold.

In the case of power and gas utilities, airports or ports presently owned by local bodies or consumer trusts, prior approval of ratepayers or consumers would be required for any sale of more than 24.9 percent.
